Table "public"."api_access_logs" {
  "log_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "api_key_id" INTEGER
  "access_time" TEXT
  "api_method" TEXT
  "api_endpoint" TEXT
  "status_code" INTEGER
  "request_body" TEXT
  "response_body" TEXT
}

Table "public"."api_keys" {
  "api_key_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_id" INTEGER
  "api_key" TEXT
  "secret_key" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "last_used" TEXT
  "permissions" TEXT
}

Table "public"."api_limits" {
  "limit_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "api_key_id" INTEGER
  "request_limit" INTEGER
  "time_window" TEXT
  "reset_time" TEXT
  "remaining_requests" INTEGER
}

Table "public"."cryptocurrencies" {
  "crypto_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "crypto_symbol" TEXT
  "crypto_name" TEXT
  "blockchain" TEXT
  "description" TEXT
  "website" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."deposit_addresses" {
  "address_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_id" INTEGER
  "address" TEXT
  "currency" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."exchanges" {
  "exchange_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "exchange_name" TEXT
  "api_url" TEXT
  "contact_email" TEXT
  "fees" TEXT
  "withdrawal_limits" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."market_data" {
  "data_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "pair_id" INTEGER
  "timestamp" TEXT
  "open_price" REAL
  "high_price" REAL
  "low_price" REAL
  "close_price" REAL
  "volume" REAL
  "close_time" TEXT
  "quote_asset_volume" REAL
  "number_of_trades" INTEGER
  "taker_buy_base_asset_volume" REAL
  "taker_buy_quote_asset_volume" REAL
  "ignore" INTEGER
  "candlestick_pattern" TEXT
  "technical_indicators" TEXT
}

Table "public"."notifications" {
  "notification_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_id" INTEGER
  "notification_type" TEXT
  "message" TEXT
  "sent_time" TEXT
  "status" TEXT
  "read" INTEGER
}

Table "public"."reports" {
  "report_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_id" INTEGER
  "report_type" TEXT
  "generation_time" TEXT
  "file_path" TEXT
  "status" TEXT
  "parameters" TEXT
}

Table "public"."strategies" {
  "strategy_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_id" INTEGER
  "strategy_name" TEXT
  "description" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "last_updated" TEXT
  "backtest_results" TEXT
}

Table "public"."strategy_executions" {
  "execution_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "strategy_id" INTEGER
  "execution_time" TEXT
  "status" TEXT
  "profit_loss" REAL
  "trade_ids" TEXT
}

Table "public"."strategy_parameters" {
  "param_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "strategy_id" INTEGER
  "param_name" TEXT
  "param_value" TEXT
  "param_type" TEXT
  "description" TEXT
}

Table "public"."strategy_trades" {
  "trade_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "execution_id" INTEGER
  "pair_id" INTEGER
  "trade_time" TEXT
  "price" REAL
  "quantity" REAL
  "trade_type" TEXT
  "maker_taker" TEXT
  "trade_source" TEXT
  "fee" REAL
  "slippage" REAL
}

Table "public"."support_tickets" {
  "ticket_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_id" INTEGER
  "subject" TEXT
  "message" TEXT
  "status" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."trades" {
  "trade_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "pair_id" INTEGER
  "trade_time" TEXT
  "price" REAL
  "quantity" REAL
  "trade_type" TEXT
  "maker_taker" TEXT
  "trade_source" TEXT
  "fee" REAL
  "slippage" REAL
}

Table "public"."trading_pairs" {
  "pair_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "base_crypto_id" INTEGER
  "quote_crypto_id" INTEGER
  "exchange_id" INTEGER
  "min_order_size" REAL
  "max_order_size" REAL
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
}

Table "public"."user_access_logs" {
  "log_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_id" INTEGER
  "access_time" TEXT
  "access_type" TEXT
  "ip_address" TEXT
  "user_agent" TEXT
  "device_type" TEXT
}

Table "public"."users" {
  "user_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_name" TEXT
  "email" TEXT
  "role" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "last_login" TEXT
  "referral_code" TEXT
  "affiliate_id" INTEGER
}

Table "public"."withdrawal_requests" {
  "request_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_id" INTEGER
  "address" TEXT
  "currency" TEXT
  "amount" REAL
  "fee" REAL
  "status" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
}

Ref: "public"."api_access_logs"."api_key_id" > "public"."api_keys"."api_key_id"
Ref: "public"."api_keys"."user_id" > "public"."users"."user_id"

Ref: "public"."notifications"."user_id" > "public"."users"."user_id"
Ref: "public"."reports"."user_id" > "public"."users"."user_id"
Ref: "public"."strategies"."user_id" > "public"."users"."user_id"
Ref: "public"."strategy_executions"."strategy_id" > "public"."strategies"."strategy_id"
Ref: "public"."strategy_parameters"."strategy_id" > "public"."strategies"."strategy_id"
Ref: "public"."strategy_trades"."execution_id" > "public"."strategy_executions"."execution_id"
Ref: "public"."strategy_trades"."pair_id" > "public"."trading_pairs"."pair_id"
Ref: "public"."support_tickets"."user_id" > "public"."users"."user_id"
Ref: "public"."trades"."pair_id" > "public"."trading_pairs"."pair_id"
Ref: "public"."trading_pairs"."base_crypto_id" > "public"."cryptocurrencies"."crypto_id"
Ref: "public"."trading_pairs"."quote_crypto_id" > "public"."cryptocurrencies"."crypto_id"
Ref: "public"."trading_pairs"."exchange_id" > "public"."exchanges"."exchange_id"
Ref: "public"."user_access_logs"."user_id" > "public"."users"."user_id"
